verdict.rationale: PayPal publishes its US commercial rates (3.49% + fixed for Checkout, 2.99% + fixed for cards, 4.99% + fixed for Pay Later, plus an international surcharge), and agent-originated orders inherit these, so a merchant can roughly price the channel without asking sales. However, the fee page has no agentic or AI-channel fee schedule, and it does not confirm whether agentic commerce services or Store Sync carry extra charges. Access to agentic commerce services is also form-gated through the PayPal AI team. Missing for 10: an explicit published fee schedule for agent-originated transactions, published Braintree pricing for the Agent Ready ACP/UCP paths, confirmation of no add-on fees for agentic services, independent corroboration.
